purpose: Advisory inventory, matching, execution observation, and routing-learning signals. It does not execute work or grant authority.
existing_orchestration: Farm and existing routers remain authoritative for execution.

capabilities.name: Samwise Capability Intelligence
capabilities.description: Advisory registry, matching, bounded execution ledger, performance summary, and owner-reviewable routing signals.

reliability.basis: New v1 capability with intentionally sparse history.

known_limitations: Advisory only; does not execute work, change Farm routing, or grant authority.

capabilities.name: Samwise Workflow Memory
capabilities.description: Local deterministic formation of bounded workflow episodes, provisional strategies, failure memory, and advisory prior-experience recommendations.

reliability.basis: New v1 capability; strategies stay provisional until repeated validated episodes exist.

known_limitations: Does not execute remembered workflows, infer missing evidence, or treat unvalidated work as successful.

capabilities.name: Samwise Owner Advisory Inbox
capabilities.description: Private local projection of meaningful evidence-backed findings for owner review and acknowledgement.

reliability.basis: New v1 projection; it preserves source confidence and suppresses routine noise.

known_limitations: Does not send notifications, execute work, alter routing, or store raw logs.

capabilities.name: Samwise Public Records Intelligence
capabilities.description: Public-record discovery, reconciliation, analysis, and consumer routing independent of any single consuming project.

reliability.basis: Registered Farm/Samwise contracts and bounded listeners.

known_limitations: Does not publish consumer records or establish findings beyond reviewed evidence.

capabilities.name: Farm deterministic listener routing
capabilities.description: Plans and records bounded listener jobs while preserving Igor availability, anomaly, and publication gates.
known_limitations: Does not replace missing adapters or take over unavailable Igor work.

capabilities.name: Igor local analytical worker
capabilities.description: Authenticated local worker for bounded structural comparisons and normalizations.

reliability.basis: Signed local protocol with narrow result validation.

known_limitations: Cannot infer missing evidence and fails closed on partial worker output.

capabilities.name: BC address validation
capabilities.description: Server-side validation against the official BC address geocoder when explicitly configured.

reliability.basis: Strict local acceptance rules around official results.

known_limitations: Unconfigured or ambiguous results fail closed; no map publication occurs.

capabilities.name: Tavily cloud research
capabilities.description: Configured cloud research preflight and retrieval path for bounded approved research work.

reliability.basis: Availability and outcome depend on configured external service and source quality.

known_limitations: Never selected for local-only work; candidate sources require downstream verification.

capabilities.name: Native app build validation
capabilities.description: Bounded inspection, build diagnosis, and owner-observed runtime validation for native applications.

reliability.basis: Early operational memory; runtime needs human observation.

known_limitations: No App Store submission, release, signing changes, or autonomous runtime assertion.

capabilities.name: Samwise work observer
capabilities.description: Local-first, explicit-scope structured operational observation and advisory pattern reporting.

reliability.basis: Explicit sessions, local journal, redaction, and deduplication.

known_limitations: No continuous capture, keylogging, clipboard capture, screenshots by default, or scope expansion.

capabilities.name: Samwise owner status
capabilities.description: Bounded owner-facing status over registered public-record capabilities and listeners.
known_limitations: Reports bounded status and does not execute remediation.

capabilities.name: Samwise Unified Signals
capabilities.description: Read-only owner brief that projects evidence-backed Owner Advisory items and source availability without creating another semantic authority.

reliability.basis: New local-only retrieval projection; external bridge availability is separately verified.

known_limitations: Does not query arbitrary files, SQL or raw logs; it does not prove an external MCP bridge is live.

capabilities.name: Samwise Farm Steward
capabilities.description: Policy-gated, locally audited selection and execution seam for earned low-risk maintenance work.

reliability.basis: New v1 policy gate; initial entries remain inactive until owner approval and earned-history review.

known_limitations: No active autonomous policy entry is seeded; it cannot publish, contact, mutate production, spend paid-cloud budget, or modify policy.
